name: Sinking Creek Ranch
note: New Ozarks campground on Sinking Creek near Bunker, beside the Mark Twain NF (1077 County Road 5615): 15 full-hookup 30/50-amp pads up to 90 ft at $40 a night all in ($50 Fri/Sat; weekend stays need both nights), 5 dry sites, glamping tents and primitive sites. Online booking (ResNexus). Pin is the street address - satellite imagery predates the pads. --Claude

name: Papa Chubby's Lakeside Resort
